# Synthetic PNAM fixtures

These random-weight models and golden outputs are generated by
`Tests/generate_hyper_a2_fixture.py` and `Tests/generate_switch_fixture.py` in
[DLC86/NamParametricPlugin](https://github.com/DLC86/NamParametricPlugin/tree/03b423f336dbfb4f86308e65445f468e2e00ad46/Tests).
They contain no recorded gear audio and are intended for automated tests only.
The manifests include PyTorch reference outputs, mixed knobs and all combinations
of three independent switches with 3, 2 and 5 positions.
